'''Keya Durns''' was the daughter of [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Jonas Durns]]. She was known to be beautiful, but icy-eyed and remote. She was skilled in [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]] operations, brawling, and space transport repair, among other things. She was also known to be skilled with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. She joined her father, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], and the professional treasure hunter [[Sig Coven]] on a successful expedition to find the fables pirate ship ''[[Kragg's Fury]]''.
